# SPSM v5.4 value-of-computation routing pilot

This pilot treats an incomplete-context model as the cheap predictor and the full state-action Transformer as the expensive predictor.
The route decision is learned as a simple ID-fitted confidence threshold on the cheap model, then evaluated on ID and OOD variants.

## Interpretation

This is not yet the final value-of-computation model. It is the zero-new-training routing audit. The key quantities are the oracle utility and the gap between oracle routing and the ID-fitted confidence-threshold router. A large oracle gap means that a learned gain model is justified; a strong ID-threshold transfer would mean cheap confidence already carries much of the routing signal.
